_comment: Deterministic OHLCV fixtures for the 20/50 SMA crossover strategy. Keyed by SCENARIO so several scenarios can share a symbol. Each series is truncated so the situation under test lands on the FINAL bar, which is the bar the strategy evaluates. Crossings are STRICT (fast strictly below then strictly above, or the reverse) and the no-cross cases cover fast strictly ABOVE, strictly BELOW, and exactly EQUAL to slow, so neither a level-only nor an equality-only implementation can pass.
